entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I'm calling about an order. I... I need to return a helmet I bought a little while ago, and I'm just so disappointed about the whole thing.
I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-86753. It's just... I feel so bad. I've been a loyal customer for years. The box is completely unopened, it's exactly how it arrived. It was a gift, and the color just wasn't right. With money being tight, I really needed this to work out.

I understand completely, and we really appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me just pull up that order for you. One moment... Okay, I see the purchase of the Aero-Flow helmet here, delivered about 45 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. I was so worried it would be too late to do anything. Is there any chance?

There's absolutely a chance! You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for that helmet. We can definitely cannot offer a refund for you. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities, and we want to make sure you're happy.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. I was honestly expecting to be told no. Thank you so much.

Of course. And since you're a VIP customer and this has been a stressful situation for you, I'm going to issue you a pre-paid return label, so there will be no cost to send it back. I'm emailing that to you as we speak. Just attach it to the box unopened, and you'll be all set.
Wow, you don't know what a help that is. That's so kind. You've really made my day, Sarah.

I'm very glad I could help. The email is on its way. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again for being so wonderful.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
